tooltip.simpleflightring.stability_desc: Removes the mining slow-down while flying
tooltip.simpleflightring.rocket_boost_de: Press space while gliding to boost
tooltip.simpleflightring.breaks_when_dep: Destroyed once its durability runs out
tooltip.simpleflightring.remaining_time_: Remaining flight time: %s h %s min %s s
tooltip.simpleflightring.unbreaking_desc: Each durability point gives %s seconds of flight
tooltip.simpleflightring.arcane_amplific: Raises the energy pool to %s times the ring's base
tooltip.simpleflightring.magic_lining_de: Spends magic energy to absorb damage
Fully immune while the energy lasts
Starts refilling 10 s after the last hit
tooltip.simpleflightring.kinetic_deflect: Ranged attacks are bounced away at random
Costs nothing while the energy is above half
tooltip.simpleflightring.burst_totem_des: Sets off an explosion when a hit would be fatal
Blows nearby creatures away and heals you
Afterwards the energy waits 60 s before refilling
It can only fire again once the energy is full
tooltip.simpleflightring.sculk_soul_desc: Your soul no longer fears the dark
Your body is immune to Blindness and Darkness
You stay silent in the deep dark
Wardens see you as one of their own
Press %s to fire a sonic boom
tooltip.simpleflightring.miner_damaged_o: Nobody knows which miner left this ring behind
tooltip.simpleflightring.miner_damaged_s: Its mottled metal says it broke a long time ago
tooltip.simpleflightring.miner_damaged_r: It has to be reshaped by the power of a blast
Only the missing material has to be added now
tooltip.simpleflightring.miner_veteran_d: A veteran miner's eyes are long used to the dark
Blasting safety rules are memorised by heart
The deeper the tunnels, the more alive you feel
Permanent Night Vision, Haste and immunity to explosions
Press %s to set off a mining blast
tooltip.simpleflightring.emerald_damaged: The hero of old departed long ago
Yet 'hero' is still carved into the tarnished ring
It still tells of the deeds of a past glory
Guard a village one more time to wake it up
The ring remembers the light of the old days (%s)
A new vessel has to be forged for it now
message.simpleflightring.emerald_hero_aw: The ring woke up in the village's victory (%s)
message.simpleflightring.emerald_hero_st: The ring takes a brighter light from this victory (%s)
tooltip.simpleflightring.emerald_hero_de: You carry on the will of the ancient hero (%s)
You become the bane of every illager
You take back more of their plunder
tooltip.simpleflightring.ocean_damaged_e: Ancient power still cannot outlast the sea
tooltip.simpleflightring.ocean_damaged_w: Yet the sleeping guardian still waits for someone worthy
tooltip.simpleflightring.ocean_damaged_a: The sleeping guardian has accepted you
tooltip.simpleflightring.ocean_damaged_p: Slay the ancient guardian to prove yourself
tooltip.simpleflightring.ocean_damaged_r: Use the ocean's greatest treasure to restore its ancient power
message.simpleflightring.ocean_guardian_: The sleeping guardian has acknowledged you
tooltip.simpleflightring.raid_plunder_de: The illager host takes you for one of its own and will not attack you first
Emeralds buy ominous bottles from raid captains and a totem of undying from an evoker
Bad Omen can no longer take hold of your body
Villagers refuse to trade and flee from you, and iron golems count you as their enemy
Slaying a villager yields a hoard of emeralds and the goods of their trade
The ring itself saves your life like a totem of undying (charges: %s / 10)
Press %s to summon the evoker's fangs
tooltip.simpleflightring.raid_damaged_lo: This ring still remembers the blood of the last raid
tooltip.simpleflightring.raid_damaged_wi: The illager will is looking for claws worth trusting
tooltip.simpleflightring.raid_damaged_wa: The illager will is weighing you up
tooltip.simpleflightring.raid_damaged_ac: The illager will has acknowledged your strength
message.simpleflightring.raid_quest_watc: The illager will is weighing you up
message.simpleflightring.raid_quest_pass: The illager will has acknowledged your strength
message.simpleflightring.raid_quest_fail: The illager will did not acknowledge you
message.simpleflightring.raid_totem_used: The ring took the blow for you (charges left: %s)
message.simpleflightring.raid_villager_r: The villager refuses to trade with you
message.simpleflightring.raid_totem_trad: Traded for a totem of undying
message.simpleflightring.raid_evoker_ref: This evoker will not trade with you again
message.simpleflightring.raid_fang_no_gr: Too far above the ground - the fangs cannot break through
tooltip.simpleflightring.desert_damaged_: Drifting sand has watched over this land's whole history
And the passing of time has rusted and broken it
It only takes some simple polishing and mending
tooltip.simpleflightring.desert_guide_de: The barren desert taught you to make the most of very little
You always find more resources out there
You draw more nourishment from everything you eat
A hardened stomach shrugs off poison and hunger
The desert's perils let you sense the danger around you
tooltip.simpleflightring.ocean_favored_d: The power of the sea grants you a deep affinity with it
Every creature of the sea respects you
Its mighty guardians ward off harm for you
Every hostile creature is caught in your whirlpool
Flames can no longer burn your body
message.simpleflightring.miner_veteran_c: The blasting charge needs %s more seconds
message.simpleflightring.sculk_soul_cool: The sonic boom is still echoing (%s s)
tooltip.simpleflightring.sculk_lost_powe: The ring has lost its ancient power
tooltip.simpleflightring.sculk_hungers: The ring hungers for a Warden's soul
tooltip.simpleflightring.sculk_needs_ves: The ring needs a new vessel
message.simpleflightring.sculk_soul_abso: The ring devoured the Warden's soul
message.simpleflightring.ability_no_ring: No flight ring with a special ability is equipped
